questions.q: For Paul, to live is Christ, and to die is what?
questions.evidence: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain

questions.q: At the name of Jesus, what should bow?
questions.evidence: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth

questions.q: How does Paul count his old gains, next to knowing Christ?
questions.evidence: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ

questions.q: Through whom does Paul say he can do all things?
questions.evidence: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me
